label: early original-phase j/v (and e,k,3,h) inputs, plus <DEL> in short sequences
explanation: Reset-gate coordinate that never fires in the copy phase and never at t=0. 82% of mass is in the original phase at t=2..5 (peak t=3), driven by the input token: j (6.7x lift, 33% of mass, and the top activations are nearly all j at t=2-3), then v, e, k, 3, h; mostly first occurrences of the token (in_first=1 carries 92% of mass). The other 18% is on the <DEL> step, more likely when the sequence is short (rate 16% at L=3, falling as L grows). Magnitude is highest for j at t=2-3. It does not fire on other letters/digits much (f, p, u, t, n under 5%), on repeated tokens, or late original positions (t>=7). Precision is limited: the same tokens at the same positions are inactive about 40% of the time, depending on earlier context in ways no simple variable captures.
